cohort: The study included 503 women with uncomplicated pregnancies and their newborns.
finding: Maternal pre-pregnancy BMI, gestational weight gain (GWG), and placental weight were independently correlated with neonatal birth weight percentile, while no association was found with maternal nutrition profiles.
cross-section timing: Maternal dietary intake and anthropometrics were assessed during pregnancy, and neonatal outcomes were measured at birth.
